estimand: mean paired holdout MSE(time-only)-MSE(time-plus-origin), divided by earlier training target SD squared, averaged across unique pairs
limitations: Frozen V8 environmental data have already been exposed; this is exploratory and not an independent confirmatory hypothesis test.
The source-cell mid-greenup date is not proven perceptible or temporally available before an animal's decision.
The chosen source cell is a range-based lower-latitude proxy, not a tracked individual's actual migration route.
Positive climate forecast-transfer does not identify bird cue use, biological actionability, demographic fitness or causal coordination.
Pair-level values are geographically and annually dependent; descriptive spatial bootstraps do not remove every dependence.
Large positive means are partly concentrated in 2010 and 2012; pair median and early-era sign stability require audit.
The standardized mean-squared-error improvement is NOT a probability, R2 change, or percentage, and is not bounded by one.
